mentions.name: Verimu
mentions.description: This tool helps medium and small businesses across the EU comply with the new Cyber Resilience Act requirements. It aims to make compliance frictionless via a drop-in GitHub Action, with a web-based dashboard coming soon.
mentions.problem: Medium and small businesses across the EU need to get up to speed with the new Cyber Resilience Act requirements, which start in September.
mentions.audience: Medium and small businesses across the EU
mentions.source_excerpt: Verimu - we're trying to help medium and small businesses across the EU get up to speed with the new Cyber Resiliance Act requirements (which start in September!) trying to make it as frictionless as possible - drop in a github action and you are good to go. Web based dashboard coming soon!
